comment: The class of each tool source of flowmark (S1), found by the layout of the repository (kit K286): ecosystem names the tool it uses, policy the reason no ecosystem tool applies.

scripts/check-diff-size.mts.tool: git diff --name-only --no-renames counts the files of the diff that GitHub compares for the event; the script compares that count to the 3000 files of GitHub's path filter

scripts/check-internal-paths.mts.reason: flowmark's rule (K1002) that no tracked file names a dependency's source or build output by its path; no ecosystem tool judges the paths that a repository writes in its own text

scripts/check-refs.mts.reason: flowmark's rule that every task ID a document names resolves to an item of a checklist; no ecosystem tool reads the IDs of these checklists

scripts/record-slugs.mts.tool: gh api asks GitHub's renderer, VS Code's own slugify.ts runs on markdown-it, and cargo builds gitlab-glfm-markdown, whose heading ids are recorded
